## About
T&H Tire And Auto Service is a tire shop and auto service center on Old Hickory Blvd in Old Hickory, TN. We handle tires, oil changes, brakes and suspension work, and we see drivers who bring in one car or a whole household of them.
We hold a 5 rating from 201 Google reviews. Customers tell us they like that we explain what the car needs, answer their questions and keep prices fair. You won't get pushed into repairs you don't need.
We're open every day of the week, including Sunday. Call (615) 530-0089 or stop by.

## Services
- Tires: New tires and tire service for your car or truck.
- Oil changes: Routine oil changes to keep your engine running right.
- Brake pads and rotors: Brake service, including pad and rotor replacement.
- Suspension work: Suspension repair, up to a complete suspension job.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: Yes. On Sunday we're open from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Q: What are your Friday hours?
A: On Friday we're open 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM, close for an hour, then reopen from 2:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 3602 Old Hickory Blvd in Old Hickory, TN 37138.
